messages.subject: bayesplot - mcmc functions
parts:
Hi!

Currently the mcmc_trace function has a n_warmup argument, but the mcmc_dens does not. I think it would be consistent to have a n_warmup argument to mcmc_dens. I would expect the function to throw away the warmup iterations. Not hard to do on the user side, but as a user I extract draws with warmup from Stan and then would like to pass the very same draws array to the trace and the density function. If I do that, then I endup with a wrong density plot as this include the warmup.

Feature request?

Sebastian

Oh, and the reason it's currently only possible for mcmc_trace is that it's probably the only plot for which showing the warmup can actually be useful. But I see your point about the convenience of using the same object containing the draws for plots with and without warmup, so including that argument to the other functions seems reasonable. 

Jonah
